_doc: Forest encounter props (ADR-0054): the small finds between the towns (data/encounters). Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_encounters.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn|_destroyed].glb; catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_encounters.py; existing materials only. size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z, origin at the bottom centre). The ladder stand's back (-Z) leans on a trunk: an encounter anchored on a tree measures its props from the trunk's surface.

defs.name: Camp Cooler
defs.description: A two-tone plastic cooler with a swing handle, left by a dead fire.

defs.name: Ladder Stand
defs.description: A steel ladder stand strapped to a trunk: shooting rail, mesh seat and a camo seat cushion four metres up.

defs.name: Ground Blind
defs.description: A pop-up hub blind in faded camo, its shooting windows half unzipped.

defs.name: Logging Truck
defs.description: A log truck run off the track: cab doors open, bunks and stakes, a few logs still chained on.

defs.name: Broken-down ATV
defs.description: A red quad bike nosed into the brush, a flat tyre and a box strapped to the rear rack.

defs.name: Tarp Cache
defs.description: A blue tarp pegged down over crates and jugs, weighted with stones.

defs.name: Bloom-grown Kill
defs.description: A deer dead on its side, the Bloom's felt and pale caps grown through its coat.

defs.name: Grave Cross
defs.description: Two branches lashed into a cross with cord, a name burnt into the crosspiece.

defs.name: Cordon Marker
defs.description: An orange survey stake with a laminated Cordon placard and a streamer of hazard tape.
